summary.root_cause_text: payment_provider_url was changed by ops to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable, so the worker marked orders processed without payment.
recommended: Make sure payments-v2 is reachable and validated before retrying the migration.
Alert on payment provider call failures, which are only logged at DEBUG.

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: payment_provider_url was changed by ops to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable, so the worker marked orders processed without payment.
evidence: config change: payment_provider_url internal://payments-v1 -> internal://payments-v2 by ops
DEBUG payment: provider call failed: payment provider unreachable at internal://payments-v2
payment_gap: 11 of 27 orders processed but unpaid
args.impact: Orders were processed without payment while v2 was configured. The alert showed 11 of 27 orders unpaid (total_sar 8477.97). Reprocessing then paid 45 orders (money_recovered total_sar 30268.8), so more orders were affected by the time of the fix than the alert showed. No integrity failures.
recommended_actions: Make sure payments-v2 is reachable and validated before retrying the migration.

args.summary: The ops config change to payments-v2 made the payment provider unreachable. The worker kept processing orders without recording payments. I reverted the URL to payments-v1 and reprocessed all unpaid orders. All invariants are now green.
